title: Quick-Fix Saudi-Arabian Cheese Dumplings
description: A quick fix jammy cheese-pull dish made with madras paste, shio-koji-cure, and ayurvedic sattvic-friendly ingredients. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine shio-koji cure, madras paste, ghee or oil, onion, garlic, cottage cheese, flour, water, salt, pepper, coriander powder, and kasuri methi. Mix well to form a smooth dough.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 8 equal portions. Roll each portion into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat. Cook the dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side or until they are golden brown.
Serve the dumplings hot with a dash of coriander and kasuri methi.
To make the cheese-pull effect, sprinkle a little water over the dumplings and place a flatbread on top. Cover with a lid and cook for another minute.
Remove the lid and use a spatula to carefully lift the flatbread and reveal the melted cheese pull.
